claim_ceiling: Two-mode tradeoff confirmed as fundamental structural property: no single representation dominates all metrics at any scale. Dense embeddings recover citation heritage at scale (AUC 0.79–0.85) but fail jurist gate (JP ≤ 0.43). TF-IDF citation hybrids dominate jurist preference (JP ~0.78) but fail cross-lingual alignment. Linear hybrids pass adversarial gates at optimal weight (w=0.3–0.4) but remain below TF-IDF baseline. True OOS JuristPref ceiling ~0.53 < 0.7 factory target. Full 174k dense evaluation blocked by missing 2022–2026 data and bge_↔bger_ ID mapping.
evidence_summary: 13/13 evidence refs verified accessible. Scale points: 19k/91k/122k/130k/137k/144k/174k decisions. 8 TF-IDF reps, 4 center-projected dense, 2 linear combos, 5 weight-sweep points, 3 section-specific, 6 legal_tfidf_bge variants evaluated. TF-IDF 174k formal suite: 14/14 adversarial gates PASS. Dense 22yr: 0/4 PASS both gates. Linear hybrids at 19yr/22yr: 2/2 PASS both gates at optimal weight (w=0.3→0.4 scale-dependent). Citation heritage: dense AUC 0.79–0.85 > TF-IDF citation 0.71–0.74 > TF-IDF text 0.50–0.63. Legal TF-IDF bge_ corpus: ALL FAIL (corpus mismatch, cited decisions 0.0067%, outcomes 0%). Section cross-lingual: Sachverhalt > Dispositiv > Erwaegungen. v8 holdout: leakage minimal (LangDom +0.005, JP -0.015). v18 coarse hierarchy: best purity 0.65 < 0.7. Boilerplate resistance: all reps ≈ -0.74 to -0.93 (measures language dominance). True OOS JP ceiling ~0.53 < 0.7 target. 5 blockers unfixable (upstream data/GPU/ID mapping). Negative results honestly preserved.
